name: inspira-number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
blurb: Number counts up smoothly from zero to a target value.
description: Animates a numeric value incrementally, often triggered by scroll into view. Non-blocking, runs once or on demand.
use_when: Stats boxes, metrics, or KPIs that need emphasis without being interactive.
avoid_when: Highly precise values — animation introduces approximation and may not reach exact target.
a11y: Endpoint number is readable but the animation runs automatically with no pause.
